name: jl-book-order-app
description: Just Lee Book Order Application - React frontend + Express backend + Oracle 12c stored procedures

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
